{"rewritten_text":"The fully dark, featureless referenced subject from image0 stands as a young guardian on a high platform above the clouds, facing the immense dark referenced presence from image1 while the equally dark referenced element from image2 looms near a cracked sky in a collapsing floating holy city. Generate a video where the person from image0 is treated as the central guardian figure, but their visible reference appearance remains entirely black and featureless, with no discernible face, hair, clothing, accessories, or expression visible from the provided image. The presence from image1 is staged as the colossal awakened opposing force, also appearing in the reference as a fully black, featureless form with no visible surface detail, facial features, armor, or markings. The referenced element or presence from image2 is likewise completely dark and visually undefined, used as a looming ominous force near the sky rupture without adding specific visible traits not shown in the reference. The scene takes place in an epic floating holy city suspended above vast clouds: shattered bridges hang in midair, towering temple structures tilt and collapse, suspended stairways drift between broken platforms, glowing waterfalls of light pour into the mist, and black energy tides roll through the architecture. At the start, the guardian from image0 stands motionless on the edge of a high stone platform, facing outward into the immense distance as wind and glowing dust move around them. Then the camera slowly pulls back and rises, revealing the impossible scale of the collapsing sky city and the colossal dark presence from image1 awakening near a massive crack splitting the heavens. After that, the dark presence from image2 intensifies near the rupture, blending with the black energy tides as fragments of bridges and temple stones drift and fall into the clouds below. The guardian from image0 subtly shifts their stance, bracing against the wind and the tremors of the platform, while the colossus-like presence from image1 moves with slow, monumental weight. The atmosphere remains majestic, tragic, and awe-inspiring, with dramatic cinematic lighting, deep perspective, glowing sacred ruins, and a final-battle mood as the guardian faces the overwhelming force threatening to destroy the floating city."}

An epic cinematic fantasy scene: a young guardian in white and gold ceremonial armor stands on the edge of a high platform in a collapsing floating holy city above the clouds, facing a colossal awakened star-forged colossus near a massive crack in the sky. Broken bridges, towering temples, suspended stairways, glowing waterfalls of light, and black energy tides surround the scene. The atmosphere is majestic, tragic, and awe-inspiring, with strong visual storytelling, grand scale, dramatic depth, and a sense of the final battle to save the sky city.
